get.description: The current draft plan with its revision counter (admins only, docs/0080).

post.description: Start a draft explicitly. Usually unnecessary: the first changeset starts one (docs/0081).

Apply a batch of add/update/delete operations to the draft, all or nothing.

409 stale-revision if `base_revision` is outdated, 409 lock-required / 423 floor-locked
without the edit lock, 422 changeset-invalid with per-operation errors.

Make the draft the published version (docs/0082). `base_revision` must be the revision
you reviewed. 409 publish-conflicts lists seat-label, device and assignment problems.
Start a draft whose content is exactly an older published version (docs/0082).

delete.description: Release your own lock. Idempotent; 409 if someone else holds it.

get.description: Who is editing this floor, if anyone.

post.description: Acquire the lock, or extend your own (heartbeat). 423 if someone else is editing.
Admin override: remove whoever's lock. Their draft is kept. Audited.
Refused with 409 while the building is archived: restore top-down (docs/0078).

get.description:
Version history, oldest first. Viewers see published and superseded versions only.

Uses the standard list envelope (docs/0040); history is returned in one page for now
(`next_cursor` is always null), so cursor paging can be added without breaking clients.
What changed from version a to version b: added, removed, and changed fields.
The complete plan of one version (docs/0036), with the catalog items it uses.
Units as a flat list; build the tree from `parent_id`.

post.description: `parent_id` null creates the root (409 root-exists if there is one).

patch.description: Rename, relabel or move (`parent_id`); moving under a own sub-unit is 409 unit-cycle.

put.description:
Replace all memberships at once. Without an explicit primary, the deepest unit is primary
(docs/0023).

delete.description: Only while nobody holds the position (409 in-use).
Archive (soft delete). Refused with 409 while active buildings exist (docs/0078).
